title: Siblings by Porch with Selko Border, 1941 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot of a young boy in shorts and a collared shirt standing alongside his younger toddler sister in front of a residential wooden house porch. The print features a classic 1930s-1940s decorative 'Selko' printed geometric border framing the scene. The back bears a stamped processing code or date mark '5 441', likely indicating May 1941.
